name: No Way in Hell!
source:
Seraphina, an earnest angel of Celestia, has suddenly fallen from her comforting cloudly home into the depths of the underworld. Confused and terrified, she finds herself surrounded by the disgusting, wicked demons and creatures she was taught to avoid all her life! In her efforts to survive in this unknown world and unravel the reasons behind her mysterious descent, she finds that -- THESE DEVILS ARE HOT?!?!

[from [url=https://vanillaseraphina.itch.io/no-way-in-hell]itch.io[/url]]
